note: Single source of truth for ingestion validation. Consumed by src/validate.py (Python, used by tests + simulator self-check) and by the JS in flows/bms_ingest.json (Node-RED runtime). Keep the two implementations in sync; tests/test_validation_contract.py asserts the tables below match src/validate.py.

semantic_checks.description: simultaneous heating and cooling: heating_valve > 20 and cooling_valve > 20 on the same equipment within one 5-minute step
stuck valve: valve position identical for more than 30 consecutive samples while its paired valve moves
out-of-hours operation: fan_speed > 20 outside 07:00-19:00 local on a weekday
flat-line sensor: no variation in a numeric point for more than 6 hours

sustained sensor drift: monotonic (|spearman rho| >= 0.98) over a 6-hour window, range >= 25 units, with no reversal greater than 10 units inside the window; healthy control ramps reverse inside the window and are not flagged
